scope: Presentation-only teaching-part atlas and wider explosion; historical v4 mechanical audit intentionally unchanged

verification.command: pnpm exec vitest run --project server src/lib/scene/educational-mechanism.test.ts src/lib/engine/mechanism.test.ts src/lib/scene/parts-layout.test.ts

tested_assertions: All 88 teaching records retain stable IDs and pure cloned canonical bounds
Burst starts at the displayed current-phase rigid pose, including embedded scale and axial pitch; canonicalization is a static display transition, not a physical engine cycle
All 88 exploded-to-cell AABBs match the affine transform at grid blends 0.2, 0.5, 0.9 and 1.0; offset term decays to zero at final layout
All teaching components use one shared explosion multiplier of exactly 3 at normalized inputs 0.25, 0.5 and 1
Layout suppresses cycle, spray, trapped-charge and flow effects; Internals=false suppresses teaching bounds and picking
Hidden, family/exact isolation, picking and complete/partial reverse restoration remain consistent
Teaching geometry attributes retain identical byte content and array references; index references are unchanged (merged meshes are nonindexed)

Shared utility fixture covers 675 unique IDs (587 source and 88 teaching), deterministic input order, nonoverlapping cells, containing group bounds, uniform scale and source affine CPU/shader agreement
retained_limits: Atlas normalizes each part independently using a positive uniform display scale; relative sizes and grid spacing are not physical dimensions
Teaching rod length, production phasing, timing, head ports, materials and embedding remain illustrative; no new OEM fidelity claim
The 675-ID utility fixture does not substitute for actual GPU source geometry/picking validation, owned by the renderer audit
Physical clearances and topology remain tied to the historical v4 audit; this report neither repeats nor re-certifies the historical boundary sweep

piston_shading_repair.physical_geometry: All264 meshes /795,996 position vertices, UVs, indices, triangle order and constituent ranges remain byte-identical; exactly12 piston normal buffers changed
